ops.title: ccr-core lane handoff: PR 10 merged at 25009827, final core state, A-F decisions and the C bounded path
ops.body:
Final state of the ccr-core lane (ccr-core, then ccr-core-2 after rotation). PR yasyf/cc-remote#10 "core: add config, budget, identity, tailnet and the workspace lifecycle" merged by root as squash 25009827f75fc8527bda1896ddabc4dad66d377d (bus #976) from branch head da78d804127305cf6205265e96d27068fc1a174a, which was rebased onto main e929259 (images #11) so the images branch-marketplace and autoUpdate fixes rode underneath intact. This note replaces the old lane's note 49c7b228, which never reached this clone's refs. The lane is closed; the worktree ~/.claude/worktrees/cc-remote/ccr-core (branch ccr-core) can be removed.

Design decisions a follow-up core lane must keep, with pointers at the merge commit:

A. Owned enrolled hosts are updated in place (root #913(2)). images/provision.sh carries no /var/lib/tailscale guard. internal/workspace/session.go readyTools has no kernel-mode refusal; on a stamp mismatch it reruns installTools, which on an enrolled host leaves the tailnet node, binding, daemon state and agent session files alone (no FreshScript, no enroll, no logout, no identity renewal, no checkout). The fresh-template purity check is Daemon.FreshScript (internal/tailnet/daemon.go) run from Go only when Prepare seals a NEW spare (Session.unjoined, called first in prepareSpare, only when an Enroller exists) plus the existing check inside Enroller.Enroll at claim or fresh-create time. Fixtures: TestResumeProvisionsAnEnrolledHostInPlace, TestPrepareRefusesASpareThatAlreadyJoinedATailnet (internal/workspace/lifecycle_test.go; the scripted fake's `joined` field makes FreshScript fail).

B. Image identity is checked before the ready stamp counts (root #913(3)). readyTools compares record.Image and record.ImageSpec with the session before calling Scripts.Ready, so a machine.image reference change with an unchanged stamp refuses with the destroy-and-create diagnostic and runs nothing on the machine. The pool fingerprint (internal/workspace/pool.go NewPool) already covers the profile spec including machine.image, so a reference change claims no old spare. Fixtures: TestResumeRefusesWhenOnlyTheImageReferenceChanged (harness.reimage keeps the stamp), TestAChangedImageReferenceClaimsNoSpareBuiltFromTheOldOne, TestResumeRefusesWhenTheImageDeclarationChanged now asserts zero scripts ran.

C, bounded path (root #915 then #958/#959, a declared diagnostic plateau: generic substring, then provider phrase, then name-on-the-line were all refused). ErrExists comes ONLY from the preflight Get before the create command in both backends (internal/providers/sprites/sprites.go Create, internal/providers/namespace/namespace.go Create). The text of a failed create is never read as proof: a create command that fails while the machine is then present returns ErrAmbiguous whatever the diagnostic says; otherwise the unknown-allocation error. Session.unmade keeps the record unverified with its reservation and ledger entry until destroy settles ownership. The line-grammar matcher (providers.Reports/Named/Boundary) was added in checkpoint 7 and deleted in checkpoint 8; do not reintroduce a regex. A post-create conflict classifier may return only with primary evidence (provider CLI or server source, or a typed error field) proving the exact message a name conflict emits, cited in the PR body. No such evidence exists today for either CLI (see note 90f403b on what the CLIs cannot report). Regressions over the real adapters with fake runners: TestCreateLosingARaceIsAmbiguous (both backends; fake takenAtCreate), TestCreateThatAllocatesThenFailsIsNotAConflict with cases for a timeout, the requested machine, another machine (alpha-2), another resource, the name on another line, the name before the code, and root's counterexample `rpc error: code = AlreadyExists desc = volume already exists while creating devbox alpha` (fake createFails is now a string: the stderr returned after allocating). The providertest contract still expects ErrExists on a second Create of the same name, satisfied by the preflight Get.

D. The deletion receipt must be exact (root #934). Session.discard requires found.Labels[label] == value where Session.receipt returns LabelSpare with the fingerprint the ledger's spare entry records for that machine (Pool.Ledger.ReadSpares) when the machine is a spare, claimed or not, else LabelWorkspace with the owner name. Any LabelSpare presence with another fingerprint is an unknown resource: left running, record, reservation and ledger entry kept, audit diagnostic returned ("without a label proving this ledger made it (want label=value, ...)"). Fixture: TestDrainKeepsASpareWhoseReceiptNamesAnotherFingerprint (relabelled wrapper provider).

E. Never Destroy after Get reports absence (root #934). discard's ErrNotFound branch calls nothing at the provider and retires the ledger entry. Accepted residue (root #957, nonblocking, keep scope): the backend's host-local label record and the sprite SSH key for that name stay on disk until the name is reused; records are bound to the machine's creation time (providers.Records.Labels) so they never vouch for a later machine. No cleanup API, no live cleanup. Fixture: TestDestroyOfAMachineAlreadyGoneRetiresWithoutAProviderDestroy.

F. Backends keep the receipt until observed absence (root #935). sprites.go Destroy and namespace.go Destroy re-read the machine after the destroy/expire CLI exits 0 and remove the label record (and the sprite SSH key) only on ErrNotFound; a survivor keeps its receipt and Destroy returns nil, after which Session.discard's own re-Get reports "still at the provider" and keeps the record for a retry that recognizes the owned survivor. Fixtures: TestDestroyKeepsTheReceiptUntilTheSpriteIsGone, TestDestroyKeepsTheReceiptUntilTheDevboxIsGone (fake destroySurvives).

Earlier checkpoints already on this head: ownership by label receipt only, never by creation time (#904); ErrAmbiguous when the machine exists after a create error; unverified records on fresh create; depth-1 pinned fetch; bounded spare slug; SSH Host fragments under <state>/ssh/<name>.ssh with an ssh -G regression; explicit ledger init|import; schemaVersion-2 Orca create result; images composition through internal/images Scripts (StagePlugins, Install(token, stamp), Ready(stamp), Configure) with the stamp in the pool fingerprint.

Process facts for the next lane: verification is `go vet ./... && golangci-lint run && go test -race -count=1 ./...` (Taskfile ci); the review bar is one sol xhigh finder pass through the codex skill; commits go through `ccx vcs ship` (plain git lane; after a rebase onto main push with `--no-commit --expect-remote <old head>`); heads and contracts go to release-root on the lane bus with text single-quoted; root merges, lanes never do. ccr-orca (PR #6) restacks on every core head and must be messaged on each push. Root refreshes the inventory-reference hashes in docs PR #12 itself because item A changed the provision template and therefore every image fingerprint.
